title: SCPN ICF Beam Core
description: Governed device-family repository for ion-beam and pulsed-electron-beam inertial confinement fusion configurations within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype: a validated device configuration model, diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue, level-0 device physics (the illumination geometry a particle-beam driver puts on a target, the mass inventory of a layered capsule, and the chain of efficiencies from beam to fusion energy), and tessellated and B-rep models of the layered capsule. All parameter sets are synthetic or anchored on freely published preprints; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
